name: White Bean, Eggplant & Feta Stuffed Peppers with Creamy Basil Salad
instructions: Preheat oven to broil on high and position rack in the upper third of the oven.
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.)

Trim, seed, and halve bell peppers lengthwise. Transfer to a baking sheet pan, drizzle with oil, and season with salt; arrange cut-side down. Place baking sheet in the oven and broil, flipping once, until peppers are lightly charred and tender, 6-8 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, trim and small dice eggplants.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, drain and rinse beans in a colander.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add eggplant, beans, and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until eggplant has softened, 5-7 minutes.
Meanwhile, pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons; place half in a medium bowl. (Reserve remaining basil for serving.)
Add mayo, vinegar, salt, and pepper to the bowl with the basil. Whisk to combine the dressing.

Trim and halve cucumber lengthwise, then cut crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the bowl with the dressing, along with mixed greens and half of the feta. Toss to combine the salad. (Reserve remaining feta for the next step.)
When the beans and eggplant are done, add remaining feta to the skillet. Stir to combine the filling and remove from heat.
Divide peppers between plates, stuff with bean filling, and top with reserved basil. Serve with salad on the side and enjoy!
author: Mealime
